decisions.title: Widen desktop agent cards in 'Your board' section
decisions.detail: On desktop (1280x800), give the 'Your board' agent cards their own dedicated full-width grid row (e.g. 5 columns at ~180px each) rather than squeezing all 5 cards into a narrow 440px container beside 'Latest report'.

decisions.title: Hide or dock floating bottom nav on tablet viewport (768px)
decisions.detail: Hide `body > nav` on tablet viewports (e.g. `md:hidden`), or constrain its width to max-w-md and ensure the page body has adequate bottom padding (`pb-24`) so it does not float directly on top of data graphics.

decisions.title: Refine Board Room agent node layout to prevent text clipping on mobile
decisions.detail: Adjust the grid or card padding for Megatron and Cybertron in the Board Room view so the agent title fits without mid-word truncation ('Backend & DB En...', 'QA & DevOps Eng...'), either by stacking the avatar and label vertically or using two-line text wrapping with an 11px font size.

decisions.title: Increase mobile hero bottom clearance to prevent floating navigation overlap
decisions.detail: Add `pb-20` to the mobile hero section so the prompt container and 'Convene board' button do not sit immediately behind the floating bottom navigation bar when scrolled to the initial fold.

decisions.title: Enlarge secondary tap targets ('All', 'Read', 'All sessions') with touch padding
decisions.detail: Apply `min-h-[44px] flex items-center` or transparent hit-area padding (`py-2.5`) to secondary links such as 'All', 'Read', and 'All sessions'.

decisions.title: Increase sidebar link padding to 44px on desktop
decisions.detail: In the desktop sidebar (<aside>), navigation links (height=36px) and agent links (height=40.75px) as well as the 'System' button (32x32px) are under 44px. Increasing vertical padding (e.g. py-2.5 / min-h-[44px]) will satisfy touch guidelines for touch-enabled laptops.

decisions.title: Add active indicator pill or top illumination pip to mobile bottom navigation
decisions.detail: While the active tab has high text contrast (16.82:1), adding an accent glow pill or subtle indicator bar above the active tab icon will make the active route stand out more clearly on mobile OLED screens.
